problem:
Consider the following vectors:

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

- ${a}_{1}+{a}_{2}-2{a}_{3}=0.$
- ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=0$ only if ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}={x}_{3}=0.$
- The set ${{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}$ is linearly independent.
